prompt: Which query gives the units sold on promotion for each promotion that started in 2025, counting a sale once, for the promotion its line carries?

options.text:
SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS promo_units
FROM promotions p
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
  AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date
WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.promo_id

SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS promo_units
FROM promotions p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.promo_id

SELECT p.promo_id, COUNT(*) AS promo_units
FROM promotions p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.promo_id

SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS promo_units
FROM promotions p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  AND s.order_date >= p.start_date AND s.order_date < p.end_date
WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.promo_id
